DOMINATE / FIELD NOTES

Build a content system you can actually maintain.

Consistency starts with a plan that fits your team.

01 /

Choose a repeatable rhythm

Decide how much useful content your team can make in an ordinary week. Start there rather than setting a schedule that only works when nothing else is happening.

02 /

Give every post a job

Use four pillars: point of view, proof, personality and product. A post should teach, demonstrate, introduce or explain something your audience cares about.

03 /

Capture while you work

Keep a shared list of customer questions, decisions and lessons. Get permission before showing clients or sharing their information.

04 /

Batch the production

Turn a single useful topic into a short video, a carousel or a written post. Adapt the format instead of repeating the same asset everywhere.

05 /

Review what starts conversations

Look beyond reach. Record the questions and enquiries content creates, then use those signals to choose the next topics.
